title: Morgan Stanley CEO: Fundamentals Don't Support Violent Market Correction
description: Jan. 21 -- James Gorman, chairman and chief executive officer at Morgan Stanley, discusses the scope of the global market selloff, fixed-income job cuts at the firm, his intention to remain with the bank for another five years, and whether or not he sees a rate cut coming from the Federal Reserve. He speaks from the World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland on "Bloomberg ?GO?."
